_comments: The HAND-AUTHORED Sales application — the one KI-4 said did not exist yet.
It does not replace the generated application. CodeGen auto-creates one MJ Application per schema,
and sales' is `__mj_BizAppsSales` at /app/mjbizappssales: a working entity browser with a full
generated CRUD form per record. That stays, and the demo walkthrough still uses it. This one is
additive and JOB-SHAPED — it opens on the work an account director actually does rather than on a
Why there is only ONE nav item. KI-4 recorded that custom nav items had nothing to point at,
because `ResourceType: 'Custom'` needs a registered `DriverClass` and sales had no such component.
Phase 1 added the deal workspace; Phase 2 replaced that direct mount with a SECTION that owns a
dashboard, the roster and the workspace — matching the shape contracts and orders use, where a nav
item is a section and the left rail moves within it.
Accounts, forecasting and the pipeline board are real sections later. They are absent rather than
stubbed because a nav item pointing at an unregistered component resolves to a BLANK TAB with no
error anywhere, so a dead item is worse than a missing one.
DefaultSequence 2020 sits after accounting's 2010, keeping the revenue stack in reading order in
the app switcher: accounting, then sales.

fields.Name: Sales
fields.Description: Deal pipeline management — compose a deal with its product lines, payment schedule and negotiated terms, and hand it to contracts and orders.
